title: Account Spectrum Intake Calibrator & Rollback Contract
creator: Marta Alvarez
description: Problem: We lack a consistent, auditable mechanism for converting top-account asks into prioritized roadmap commitments that balance business value, engineering risk, and platform SLOs. This ticket proposes an 'Account Spectrum' classifier + an Intake Calibrator that maps requests to lanes (Observe, Trial, Fastpass, Anchor) and a standardized Rollback Contract (de-risk terms, rollback triggers, partial-deliverables + feature-flag plan) to reduce unscoped commitments and enable predictable delivery. Goals: 1) reduce ad-hoc VIP promises, 2) shorten decision time for escalations to <48h, 3) provide clear rollback / de-scope triggers to engineering, and 4) surface SLO/cost impact in intake decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Deployment of intake scoring model (ARR, expansion potential, incident footprint, regulatory constraint, product-fit) in a single Confluence PRD and a runnable scoring spreadsheet
Intake Calibrator UI mock + decision table published to design folder, accepted by Design and Eng leads
Rollback Contract template published (customer-facing one-pager + internal checklist) and approved by Legal and CS
Pilot intake flow run with 3 top accounts (one Anchor, one Fastpass, one Trial) and two escalations resolved using the contract
SLO impact simulation dashboard (latency/cost) added to Console dev workspace with sample scenarios and runbook links
Post-pilot decision latency <48h measured across pilot requests and PM satisfaction >=80%
Playbook entry added to Top Accounts operating manual and included as a step in executive escalation runbook
steps: Finalize scoring features and weights with GTM + CS (ARR, churn risk, latency incidents, regulatory, expansion odds)
Implement scoring spreadsheet + small backend endpoint for automated scoring in intake form (MVP)
Design and review UI decision table for Calibrator (scoped to PM console page)
Draft Rollback Contract template + legal review + CS customer-facing language
Pilot with 3 accounts; record outcomes and iterate scoring thresholds
Integrate SLO/cost simulation into Console as a lightweight 'what-if' in intake flow
Ship playbook and run training for Solutions Engineering and AE teams
metrics: % of top-account asks that result in scoped commit vs deferred (target 60% scoped with rollback)
Post-commit SLO regressions attributed to committed features (target 0 regressions in pilot window)
AE/CS satisfaction with clarity of commitments (>=80% in pilot survey)
Number of partial-deliverables / rollbacks invoked (target 0-1 during pilot)
